data.narrative:
Havoc AI is a Series A-stage frontier-tech company operating in the ocean and maritime sector. The company has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe consists of two private peers—Seasats and Bedrock Ocean—reflecting the nascent and fragmented nature of this subsector; no relevant public comparables exist.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $200M total capital raised proxy. This approach yields an implied valuation of $400M. The triangulation across available methods (limited to one applicable approach) produces a range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $400M. The constrained methodology set and absence of public market benchmarks are material limitations.

Key uncertainties center on the representativeness of the private peer set, the appropriateness of the 2.0x stage multiplier for frontier-stage maritime technology, and the absence of disclosed metrics on unit economics, revenue traction, or capital efficiency. The $400M median valuation reflects capital deployed and standard progression norms, but lacks anchoring to market fundamentals or comparable transaction precedent. Refinement of this range would benefit from additional revenue or usage data and validation against downstream financing activity in the sector.
